set.body:
Objective
Turn GazeWeave-Transport into a fast, scientifically stable symmetric comparison engine while preserving GazeWeave-Replay as the directional encoding-to-recall model.

Why this epic exists
Transport v2 has demonstrated genuine order sensitivity and a positive repeated-viewing ceiling, but it has not yet shown superior real-data information over registered density or Replay. The present formulation also has a path-length scaling defect in its sparse chronology loss, uses a single study presentation in the main retrieval court, profiles coverage only at M = 0.50, 0.75, and 1.00, and remains too slow for exhaustive candidate evidence despite GW-14's estimator-preserving speedup.

Frozen scientific contract
- Primary endpoint: held-out gaze_info_bits = log2(p_true / prior_true), using the same candidates, folds, registration policy, and priors as every comparator.
- Transport remains a symmetric, coverage-conditioned registered alignment; its coupling is an optimized correspondence, not a posterior.
- Coverage, selected mass, spatial fidelity, local-order preservation, contraction, rank, and solver stability are diagnostics, not extra primary outcomes.
- Four study presentations enter as four separate, equal-prior episode components; they are never concatenated.
- Registration is cross-fitted and candidate-invariant. Isotropic contraction plus participant/session offset remains the default; affine registration is sensitivity-only.
- Algorithm and tuning choices are response-blind. Retrieval response, saliency, and correctness are examined only after the measurement model is frozen.
- Private Wynn data and derived trial-level outputs remain local and Git-ignored.

Non-goals
- Do not tune Transport to rescue the current recognition result.
- Do not claim greater power from nominal GLMM p-values alone.
- Do not replace Replay for directional mechanistic inference or force Transport to be a probability model.
- Do not make GPU, low-rank, or free affine machinery default before typical 5-30 fixation paths justify it.

Completion gate
The epic closes only when the estimand is frozen; chronology and coverage are resolution-stable; the all-four episode model and nested evidence layer are implemented; a reference and optimized solver agree within declared tolerances; synthetic and study repeated-viewing courts pass; a frozen retrieval comparison is run without retuning; the method's role is decided against density sigma 80/160, Replay, Transport v2, and a nested learned MultiMatch composite; plots, provenance, tests, documentation, runtime evidence, and package checks support the bounded claim.
set.title: GW-18 GazeWeave Transport v3: edge-normalized episode transport
